npcs.name: Gsboy1

npcs.name: Gantetsu
says: Hm? Who are you? [name], eh? You want me to make some Balls? Sorry, but that’ll have to wait. Do you know Team Rocket? Ah, don’t worry. I’ll tell you anyhow. Team Rocket’s an evil gang that uses Pokémon for their dirty work. They’re supposed to have disbanded three years ago. Anyway, they’re at the well, cutting off SlowpokeTails for sale! So I’m going to go give them a lesson in pain! Hang on, SLOWPOKE! Old Kurt is on his way!
Kurt: You have Apricorns for me? Fine! I’ll turn them into Poké Balls.
Kurt: Oh... That’s a letdown.
Kurt: Ah, [name]! I just finished your Poké Ball. Here!
Kurt: I make Poké Balls from Apricorns. Collect them from trees and bring ’em to me. I’ll make Poké Balls out of them.
Kurt: It’ll take a day to make you a Poké Ball. Come back for it later.
Kurt: I’m working! Don’t bother me!
Kurt: That turned out great. Try catching Pokémon with it.
That’s right! I’ll give you my grandpa’s number.

npcs.name: Gsbabygirl1
says: The SLOWPOKE are gone... Were they taken away by bad people?
Grandpa’s gone... I’m so lonely...
The SLOWPOKE my dad gave me came back! Its tail has grown back, too!
You want to talk to my grandpa, don’t you?
Dad works at Silph where he studies Poké Balls. I have to stay home with Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.
[name] registered Kurt in the Pokégear!
My grandpa can tell you more about Apricorns.

npcs.name: Follower Mon Static Slowpoke

npcs.name: Gsbabyboy1

npcs.name: Middlewoman1 2

npcs.name: Fishing 2

npcs.name: Gsgentleman

npcs.name: Gsleader2
says: Bugsy: I’m Bugsy! I never lose when it comes to Bug-type Pokémon. My research is going to make me the authority on Bug-type Pokémon! Let me demonstrate what I’ve learned from my studies.

[name] received the Hive Badge from Bugsy!

Bugsy: Do you know the benefits of the Hive Badge? If you have it, Pokémon up to Lv. 30 will obey you, even traded ones. Pokémon that know Cut will be able to use it outside of battle, too. Here, I also want you to have this.
Bugsy: Bug-type Pokémon are deep. There are many mysteries to explore. Study your top choices thoroughly.
Bugsy: TM89 contains U-turn. It lets your Pokémon attack, then switch with the next Pokémon in your party. Isn’t that great?

npcs.name: Gsassistantm
says: You can call me the Judge. Heheh, it’s actually not my real name, but that’s what everyone calls me. It’s because of this weird power I have. It’s a gift, really. If you’d like, I could judge the intriguing potential of your Pokémon.
...Oh. You don’t need me to judge. I get it.
Judge an Egg?! That’s a tall order even for me.
I see, I see... This Pokémon’s potential is decent all around. That’s my determination, and it’s final.
I see, I see... This Pokémon’s potential is above average overall. That’s my determination, and it’s final.
I see, I see... This Pokémon has relatively superior potential overall. That’s my determination, and it’s final.
I see, I see... This Pokémon has outstanding potential overall. That’s my determination, and it’s final.
It’s rather decent in that regard. That’s how I judged it.
It’s very good in that regard. That’s how I judged it.
It’s fantastic in that regard. That’s how I judged it.
It can’t be better in that regard. That’s how I judged it.

You defeated Clair? That’s amazing! I’ve never heard of her losing to anyone other than Lance.

npcs.name: Gsoldman1
says: If Clair allows it, her grandfather-- our Master--will also. You may enter.

npcs.name: Gsleader8
says: Clair: I am Clair. The world’s best Dragon-type master. I can hold my own against even the Pokémon League’s Elite Four. Do you still want to take me on? ...Fine. Let’s do this! As a Gym Leader, I will use my full power against any opponent!

Clair: I won’t concede this. I might have lost, but you’re still not ready for the Pokémon League. I know. You should take the Dragon-master challenge. Behind this Gym is a place called Dragon’s Den. There is a small shrine at its heart. Go there. If you can prove that you’ve lost your lazy ideals, I will admit you are a Trainer worthy of a Gym Badge!
Clair: You’ve kept me waiting! Here! Take this!
Clair: That contains Dragon Pulse. Well, Dragon Pulse is a kind of...umm... Never mind! It’s a huge energy of some kind. If you don’t want it, you don’t have to take it.
Clair: What’s the matter? Is it too much to expect of you?

Clair: What’s the matter? Aren’t you headed to the Pokémon League? Your face...it tells me you have some unfinished business... Wait a sec! You came from New Bark Town where Professor Elm’s Lab is, right? You may want to go back to New Bark Town. Whatever you have to face from now, it’ll be more difficult. But don’t you dare give up! If you do, I’ll feel even worse about having lost to you! ... Give it your all.

npcs.name: Sunglasses
says: Yo! Champ in the making! The Gym has unstable footing. Keep your Pokémon in their Poké Balls. Now, Clair uses the mythical and sacred Dragon-type Pokémon. You can’t damage them very easily. But you know, they’re supposed to be weak against Ice-type moves.
Hey! You were great to beat Clair! What she says is one thing, but you are already quite the Trainer. I think... I’d still do what Clair wants you to do, though.

npcs.name: Follower Mon Static Dratini

npcs.name: Gsgirl1
says: DRAGONAIR’s cute, but I don’t have it. Do you have DRAGONAIR㊛? Want to trade it for my DODRIO?

Wow! Thank you! I always wanted DRAGONAIR!
You don’t want to trade? Oh, darn...
That’s not DRAGONAIR㊛. Please trade with me if you get one.

npcs.name: Gswoman1
says: Oh? Your [name]...

[name] received the Effort Ribbon.
[name] put the Effort Ribbon on [name].
Oh! That Effort Ribbon looks good on your [name]!
It’s working a little harder, I see. But it will need some more effort!
It’s working hard, I see. But it will need just a little more effort!
It’s working quite hard, I see. But it will need a tiny bit more effort!
It’s working so hard, I see. It’s almost there. Just the smallest bit of effort, and it’ll be there!
It needs to work a little harder. If it does, I’ll give your Pokémon something nice.

npcs.name: Gsmiddleman1
says: Um... Who did you say I was again? ... ... Oh, yes, I remember now! I’m the Move Deleter!
You’ve come to make me force your Pokémon to forget some moves?
Which Pokémon should forget a move?
Remember me if there are moves that need to be forgotten.
OK, then. Which move should be forgotten?
Hm! The move [name]? Should that move be forgotten?
What? That’s an Egg. No Egg should know any moves.
That Pokémon knows only one move, so it can’t be forgotten...
It worked perfectly! Your Pokémon has forgotten the move [name] completely.

npcs.name: Gsbigman
says: Ha! That’s it! That’s an honest-to- goodness Heart Scale! Let me guess, you want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move?
Which Pokémon needs tutoring?
Which move should I make it remember?
[name] handed over one Heart Scale in exchange.

Me? I’m the Pokémon Move Maniac. I know every move that Pokémon learn while they’re leveling up, and I can make Pokémon remember those moves. I can make a Pokémon of yours remember a move if you’d like. But...ahem! It’ll cost you. I’ll make a Pokémon remember a move if you’ll trade me a Heart Scale.
If any of your Pokémon needs to learn a move, come back with a Heart Scale.
Hunh? Don’t you think it’d be tough for an Egg to remember a move? It’s not even hatched.
Sorry... There isn’t any move I can make that Pokémon remember.

npcs.name: Gsoldman1
says: Your quest for power has brought you here... Very well. Let me reward your passion with some absolutely astounding moves. They’re the ultimate moves! Shall I teach them to your Pokémon?
The ultimate moves! Shall I teach them to your Pokémon?
To which Pokémon should I teach a move?
Hmm... Well, that is fine, as well. Visit if you have a change of heart.
Teach a move to an Egg? Impossible even for me! Keh!
That Pokémon can’t learn a move! Read the memo there! Keh!
That Pokémon already knows the move I’ve offered to teach! Keh!
You’ve not bonded strongly enough with your Pokémon! Keh!
I should teach Blast Burn to your [name]?
I should teach Hydro Cannon to your [name]?
I should teach Frenzy Plant to your [name]?

npcs.name: Gsoldwoman1
says: Hohoho... They call me Grandma Wilma. I sense a slight talent as a Dragon Tamer in you. Would you like me to teach a move to one of your Pokémon?
Ah, it is you again... Would you like me to teach the best Dragon-type move I know to one of your Pokémon?
Well, perhaps if you change your mind, do come back.

npcs.name: Gsman2
says: For Pokémon, happiness is being with a person who treats them well.

I... I’m in shock! A guy about your age with piercing eyes and long hair came in. He scared me into giving him my prized Pokémon! I still have one left, but what if he comes back? You look strong. Could you look after my Pokémon for a while?
Oh, no... What’ll I do if he comes back?
Hi! How’s my Pokémon?
Hi! How’s my Pokémon? I think I’m safe now, so may I have it back?
Your Pokémon party is full.
Oh, no, no... That’s the same as being robbed.
Hey, that’s not my Pokémon.
Oh, thank you! Take good care of it, please!
[name] received a Pokémon!
Huh? It’s holding an item. You should keep that.
Huh? Its Poké Ball has a Ball Capsule on it! Please remove it.
Huh? You...only have one Pokémon! You can’t give it back to me then.
Thank you!
My Pokémon has come to like you. All right, you should keep it. But promise to be good to it!

npcs.name: Sunglasses
says: What’s up? Need some medicine?
Huh? You need medicine? Your Pokémon appear to be fine. Is something worrying you? ... The Lighthouse Pokémon is in trouble? I got it! This ought to do the trick.
My SecretPotion is a tad too strong. I only offer it in an emergency.

npcs.name: Fishing 2
says: Hi. You must be a sightseer! Why not take a picture here? You saw the camera outside? I put it there! You may come across my relatives here and there. Anyway, go ahead and take a picture! Check the camera, and it’ll take a picture for you. It’ll be a good memory of your journey with your Pokémon!

npcs.name: Gswoman1
says: You came from Olivine? Do you remember the four islands along the way? I heard that a mythical sea creature is hiding in them.

npcs.name: Gsbabygirl1
says: I’ve heard that the whirlpools around the islands are caused by the sea creature. You might need a special move to get past them.

npcs.name: Gsgirl1
says: I heard that you can only see it if you have a Silver Wing. It must have the same scent as the creature.

npcs.name: Gsman1
says: You can’t help showing off the Pokémon you have, don’t you agree? I’d love to show mine to a friend of mine who lives in Violet...

Huh? Do you happen to... have only one Pokémon? That must be hard on you. ... That’s right! I’ll give you a TENTACOOL! I just caught a little too many. I was going to release it, so take it. Go ahead!
[name] received the TENTACOOL!
Want to give a nickname to the TENTACOOL?

npcs.name: Gsgirl1
says: Have you met the maniac in this city? He’s always bragging about his rare Pokémon.

npcs.name: Sunglasses
says: The Pokémon at this Gym are all rough and tough. They could blow me away in a second. Let me give you a piece of advice. The Gym Leader uses Fighting-type Pokémon. You can try to fool them with Psychic-type Pokémon. Or simply defeat them before they can demonstrate their power. By the way, Chuck, the Gym Leader, is into his waterfall training. He won’t be able to hear you unless you somehow stop the pounding water.
[name]! You won, didn’t you? Your face tells me you did.

npcs.name: Middlewoman1 2
says: Oh! You’ve managed to get a Clear Bell? The old-time dream of mine... I see... You’ve done it... ... ...I can hear it! The chime of the bells on the wind coming from the direction of the Bell Tower...

Have you heard of the Bell Tower in Ecruteak? There are what they call Clear Bells on top of the tower. They don’t make a single noise in strong winds. There is only one way to make them ring. It is to obtain another Clear Bell just like the ones at the top of the tower. I went after it when I was young. But I never got one...

I don’t remember the last time someone came to visit me. When I was young, I was a Pokémon Trainer, too. I tried to reach the tower and dive into the ocean. I put a lot of effort into many things. Well, I take things easy now, listening to the waves and winds on this beach.

Oh! You’ve managed to get a Tidal Bell? The old-time dream of mine... I see... You’ve done it... ... ...I can hear it! The chime of the bells on the sea breeze coming from the direction of the Whirl Islands...

Have you heard of Whirl Islands? There are what they call Tidal Bells at its waterfall basin. They don’t make a single noise in crashing waves. There is only one way to make them ring. It is to obtain another Tidal Bell just like the ones at the waterfall basin. I went after it when I was young. But I never got one...

npcs.name: Gsleader16
says: Who are you? My name’s Blue. I was once the Kanto Champion. Although it was short-lived thanks to Red... Anyway, take a good look around you...
Blue: You are quite something! You defeated Red!? That’s great! Let’s take a picture together!
Blue: All right!
Blue: Thanks for the nice picture!
If you want to battle me...for real, show me how many Kanto Badges you’ve got. ... [name]... You’re not ready to battle me...

Blue: A volcano erupts, and just like that, a whole town disappears. We can go on winning and losing in Pokémon, but if nature so much as twitches, we can be overwhelmed in a second... That’s the way it is... But, anyway, I’m still a Trainer. If I see a strong opponent, it makes me want to battle.
Blue: Oh, well...
Your Photo Album is full. Access your PC and delete some pictures.
If you want to battle me...for real, come to the Viridian Gym.
I’ll be waiting for you!

npcs.name: Gsleader15
says: Blaine: I’ll never give up until the day I’ve rebuilt the Cinnabar Gym! Why not exchange numbers!
Blaine: Oh, it is you! Say, do you want to take a picture with me right here?
Blaine: There, stand next to me!
Blaine: Oh, this is a good picture!
Blaine: Do we want to exchange numbers?
Blaine: Noooo!
Your Photo Album is full. Access your PC to delete some pictures.
[name] registered Blaine in the Pokégear!
Blaine: Hmmm... We should be able to battle on Tuesday evenings!
Blaine: Oh...how disappointing!

npcs.name: Seaman 2
says: It’s been a year since the volcano erupted. It is so fortunate that everyone evacuated in time.

npcs.name: Gswoman3
says: I feel so sorry for Blaine. He lost his Gym...

npcs.name: Gsleader14
says: Brock: Small spaces surrounded by rocks make you feel peaceful, don’t you agree? By the way, do you want to exchange numbers?
Brock: Can we exchange numbers?
Brock: I am looking for BONSLY. Are you saying you’ll trade it for my RHYHORN?
Brock: Hey, you! Why don’t you take a picture with me?
Brock: All righty! Stand next to me and relax!
Brock: Yes! Another great memory!

Brock: Hi, [name]! Have you seen a Pokémon called BONSLY? They say you have to get it from an Egg... I am having a hard time finding one. If you happen to have a BONSLY, could you trade it for my RHYHORN?
Brock: All right! Let’s trade!

Brock: Thank you! I have been looking for BONSLY! The RHYHORN I gave you knows the move Thunder Fang! I trained it from an Egg. I’m so proud of it, because it can take down Water-type Pokémon, which usually are a tough matchup. Take good care of it for me!

Brock: That RHYHORN I gave you knows Thunder Fang! I trained it from an Egg. I’m so proud of it, because it can take down Water-type Pokémon, which usually are a tough matchup. Take good care of it for me!
Brock: Well... That’s OK.

Brock: I would love to have a Pokémon battle against you! Give me a call on Saturday nights!
Brock: I see... How disappointing. I would love to have a Pokémon battle against you...
Brock: I thought you might have one, but I guess it’s not that easy... If you find one, remember to trade with me, OK?
Brock: Hey, now! That is not a BONSLY!

Clair: You... seem desperate to take pictures with me.
Clair: Are you ready?
Clair: Excellent one of me! Another cool picture.
Clair: So you do want to exchange numbers?
Clair: That’s too bad.

npcs.name: Gsrivel
says: [name]: ... What? [name]? Yeah, I am training my Pokémon here. You can laugh at me now... But it needs to be done. My Pokémon aren’t ready to beat you. I can’t push them too hard now. I have to be disciplined to become the greatest Pokémon Trainer...
[name]: ... Whew... Learn to stay out of my way...

npcs.name: Chourou
says: By the way... Have you heard of LUGIA? It is a Pokémon said to have lived around Whirl Islands once... ...Never mind. Just mad words of the old.
Clair appears to have learned an invaluable lesson from you. I thank you as her grandfather.
Dragon Pokémon are symbolic of our clan. You have shown that you can be entrusted with one.
Hm... Good to see you here. Your arrival is most fortunate. I have something for you. Take this DRATINI as proof that I now know your worth.
Hm? Your party is full.
There is a huge waterfall deep in the cave there. It is said that LUGIA rests in the deep end of the waterfall basin... You need a Silver Wing to reach the waterfall basin, I’ve heard...
[name] received DRATINI from the Master!
Give a nickname to the DRATINI you received?

npcs.name: Gsoldman1
says: It’s been quite some time since a Trainer has gained our Master’s rare approval. In fact, not since Master Lance.

npcs.name: Gsoldman1
says: You know young Master Lance? He looks so much like our Master did in his youth. It’s in their blood.

npcs.name: Gsgirl1
says: The tower that used to be here... I heard that it used to be much taller before it was burned by a fire.
They say that they will start the construction work to rebuild this tower soon!
Three big Pokémon ran off in different directions. What were they?

npcs.name: Gsboy1
says: If you go west from this city, you’ll reach a port called Olivine City. When your Pokémon learns Surf, you can go out to the ocean from Route 40 without a ship!

npcs.name: Gsbigman
says: Oh! That’s a nice Pokémon you’re walking with! They make you feel uplifted, don’t they? They give us the hope of the light, so to speak. Speaking of the light, I heard something about the Lighthouse in Olivine. The Pokémon that serves as the beacon has fallen ill. Sounds like it’s in trouble.
The Pokémon at that Lighthouse in Olivine has fully recovered. I heard that boats can safely sail out to sea at night again.

npcs.name: Gsoldman1
says: Ecruteak used to have two towers, one in the east and one in the west.
Have you heard that they are talking about rebuilding the Burned Tower? There will be two towers again! I’m looking forward to it!

npcs.name: Gsoldman1
says: Hmm... I thought I just heard a woman screaming or something... Is that just me?
Kimono Girls are always rehearsing their dances at the Dance Theater there.

npcs.name: Gsgirl2
says: I’m going to rehearse at the Dance Theater. Care to join me?

npcs.name: Gsoldman1
says: In the distant past... When this tower burned in a fire, three nameless Pokémon perished in it. Then, a rainbow-hued Pokémon descended from the sky and somehow brought them back... The people were afraid of power such as the rainbow-hued Pokémon had shown. They tried to control it by force. The nameless Pokémon made no attempt to fight back. Instead, their great sorrow compelled them to leave. This legend has been passed down by the Ecruteak Gym Leader. Me? I was a Trainer way back when. Ho ho ho!

npcs.name: Gsoldwoman1
says: If you use Revive, a Pokémon that has fainted will wake right up.

npcs.name: Gsman1
says: My EEVEE evolved into an ESPEON. But my friend’s EEVEE turned into an UMBREON. I wonder why? We both were raising our EEVEE in the same way...

npcs.name: Sunglasses
says: Yo! Champ in the making! The Trainers here use Ghost-type Pokémon at will. A ghost is like a shade or a phantom... It won’t do any good to use physical strength alone.
Whew, [name]. You did great! I was cowering in the corner out of pure terror!

npcs.name: Gsleader4
says: Morty: It’s good of you to have come. Here in Ecruteak, Pokémon have long been revered. It’s said that a rainbow-hued Pokémon will come down to appear before a truly powerful Trainer. I believed that tale, so I have secretly trained here all my life. As a result, I can now see what others cannot. I see a shadow of the person who will make the Pokémon appear. I believe that person is me! You’re going to help me reach that level!
Morty: I don’t think our potentials are so different. But you seem to have something more than that... So be it. This Badge is yours.
[name] received the Fog Badge from Morty!
Morty: By having the Fog Badge, Pokémon up to Lv. 50, including traded Pokémon, will obey you. Also, Pokémon will be able to use Surf. Here is another thing... I want you to have this, too.

Morty: I get it... The person the Kimono Girls were talking about must be you... Never mind. You should be strong enough to go across the sea. When you go west and then south, you’ll reach Olivine City. Why don’t you head for it?
Morty: It’s Shadow Ball. It causes damage and may reduce Special Defense. Use it if it appeals to you.

npcs.name: Sign
says: Ecruteak City Pokémon Gym
Ecruteak City Pokémon Gym Leader: Morty Certified Trainer! [name]

npcs.name: Sign
says: Ecruteak City Pokémon Gym
Ecruteak City Pokémon Gym Leader: Morty Certified Trainer! [name]

npcs.name: Gsassistantm
says: Lake of Rage... The appearance of a red GYARADOS... I smell a conspiracy. I know it!

npcs.name: Gswoman3
says: Morty, the Gym Leader, is soooo cool. His Pokémon are really tough, too.

npcs.name: Gsmiddleman1
says: Kimono Girls are so pretty. The way the Kimono Girls dance and the way they use their Pokémon are both marvels.

npcs.name: Bozu
says: Past here is the Bell Tower. This tower was built as a place of rest for HO-OH, the legendary Flying-type Pokémon. Since HO-OH left, many people have gone up to the tower to try to bring it back. But none have succeeded in making HO-OH appear... Morty, the Gym Leader, is one who has tried. You don’t seem to have the Ecruteak Gym Badge. If you can’t even defeat Morty, going up there will be a waste of time. Sorry, but you’ll have to leave.
Having been able to witness HO-OH coming back to this tower is more than worth the training I have gone through.
Please, do go on.

Past here is the Bell Tower. This tower was built as a place of rest for HO-OH, the legendary Flying-type Pokémon. Since HO-OH left, many people have gone up to the tower to try to bring it back. But none have succeeded in making HO-OH appear... Morty, the Gym Leader, is one who has tried. I see... That’s the Ecruteak Gym Badge. The Badge alone will not do any good, but I can let you through. Please, do go on.

Morty, the Gym Leader, ascended this tower to try to bring back HO-OH, because it no longer appears. Even he couldn’t bring it back. You don’t seem to have the Ecruteak Gym Badge. If you can’t even defeat Morty, going up there will be a waste of time. Sorry, but you’ll have to leave.
I see... That’s the Ecruteak Gym Badge. The Badge alone will not do any good, but I can let you through. Please, do go on.

npcs.name: Bozu
says: The rainbow-hued Pokémon flying gracefully over the tower... The silvery, sparkling Pokémon resting gently upon the whirling seabed... All of this is far beyond my imagination.

npcs.name: Bozu
says: Only those who possess the Rainbow Wing are given permission to go up to the top of the Bell Tower... But the rainbow-hued Pokémon will not come down for just anybody who goes up there. There must be something else you need. I’ve heard the Kimono Girls know something about it.
Such a young one to take on HO-OH...
The Bell Tower shook! It must be HO-OH... HO-OH must have returned to the top!
The Johto region has two legends. One is the legend about Whirl Islands. The other is the Bell Tower legend... We have been passing down the Bell Tower legend for generations in Ecruteak City.

npcs.name: Gsman3
says: Ah. You’re on an adventure with your Pokémon? Well, what’s an adventure without treasure hunting? Am I right, or am I right?

There are many items lying about that aren’t obvious. Touch the Dowsing Machine for a while to see if it makes a high-pitched noise. When it does, you know there is an item near you. Walking as you use it may make it easy to find items. Oh yeah--I heard there are items in Ecruteak’s Burned Tower.
Good! You understand the true spirit of adventure. I like that! Take this with you.
Oh... To each his own, I suppose...

npcs.name: Babyboy1 2
says: History of Ecruteak Want to read it?
In Ecruteak, there were two towers. Each tower was the roost of powerful flying Pokémon. But one of the towers burned to the ground. The two Pokémon haven’t been seen since... Keep reading?

Ecruteak was also home to three Pokémon that raced around the town. They were said to have been born of water, lightning, and fire. But they could not contain their excessive power. So they say the three ran like the wind off into the grassland.

npcs.name: Gsoldman1
says: This happened when I was young. The sky suddenly turned black. A giant Flying-type Pokémon was blocking out the sun. I wonder what that Pokémon was? It was like a bird and like a dragon.

npcs.name: Gsboy1
says: Is there really a Pokémon that big? If it exists, it must be powerful.

npcs.name: Gsoldwoman1
says: The Kimono Girls are so beautiful... But they have to go through rigorous training. And they have to learn to follow customs before appearing in public. But if you love something, anything is possible.
Quite the Trainer for your age indeed!
To do such a terrible thing to a Kimono Girl! I don’t understand how young people behave these days.

npcs.name: Gsman1
says: That man’s always with his PSYDUCK. Says he wants a Pokémon that can Surf and dance. Is he trying to make a Pokémon that stars at synchronized swimming?
I was supposed to be the hero...! So much for getting close to a Kimono Girl!
Oh... Ouch...! This stomachache! I wouldn’t let this guy act like that were it not for this pain...!
Oh... Ouch...! This back pain! I wouldn’t let this guy act like that were it not for this pain...!
Oh... Ouch...! This toothache! I wouldn’t let this guy act like that were it not for this pain...!

npcs.name: Gsgentleman
says: What’s the deal with that Team Rocket Grunt, messing with my Kimono Girl? You are a Trainer, aren’t you? Please help her!
Not only are the Kimono Girls great dancers, they’re also skilled at Pokémon. But they battle only for good reasons. I don’t know if you could defeat them if they showed what they can do...

npcs.name: Follower Mon Static Psyduck
says: PSYDUCK: Dau dau!

npcs.name: Dancer
says: Talk to Zuki in the middle when you are ready.
Thank you for your help the other day.

npcs.name: Dancer
says: Talk to Zuki in the middle when you are ready.
We are rehearsing a dance.

npcs.name: Dancer
says: For Kimono Girls like me, dancing is everything. I have never gone a day without a dance practice. Pokémon are the same. They grow with you little by little each day.

You must be [name], correct? That was indeed excellent. Kind and strong... Good at raising Pokémon as well... That person does know what to look for in people... Ohoho! That was just me talking to myself. Never mind.

npcs.name: Dancer
says: Talk to Zuki in the middle when you are ready.
We are rehearsing a dance.

npcs.name: Dancer

npcs.name: Rocketm
says: Huh? Who are you? You dare to get in my way?
Oh, no! You make me look like a villain!
Oops! I have an important mission. If they find out I was wasting time here, they’ll make me start over as the lowest Team Rocket Grunt! I better leave now!

npcs.name: Dancer
says: I will test you to see if you are a good Pokémon Trainer. Are you ready?

Thank you for your help the other day. You have beautifully proven that the bond between people can be extended to the bond between people and Pokémon... We all appreciate that you have lived up to our expectations, [name]! If you feel that this experience has taught you anything, the people you should thank are not us, but Mr. Pokémon and Professor Elm...
That is fine... I will wait for you to get ready.
I will test how closely you’ve bonded with your Pokémon!

You are quite strong. You helped me in the Ilex Forest. My name is Naoko. I’m the one that’s not so good at directions. My eyes witnessed you defeating Team Rocket when Kurt was in trouble at the SLOWPOKE Well. Allow me to challenge you and your Pokémon!

You are quite the Trainer. I remember you chasing off that Team Rocket Grunt from right here. I must thank you for that. Although, I am actually a Trainer myself. She who knows the most speaks the least! I am Miki--the Kimono Girl! Allow me to challenge you and your Pokémon!

Excellent fighting spirit! You got me off the ice by pushing me from the back. I am the one who skates in sandals. I am Sayo--the Kimono Girl! I was listening in the Dragon’s Den when you passed the test of the Elder. Allow me to challenge you and your Pokémon!

I am the last one. You were so dependable at the Goldenrod Tunnel. I am the one who twirls even underground. I am Kuni--the Kimono Girl! I looked at you in wonder when you thwarted Team Rocket’s mission to take over the Radio Tower. You must show your strength to me now. Allow me to challenge you and your Pokémon!
We were not wrong about you. You are indeed worthy of this... Please take it.
Big sisters! I just saw the big shadow of a Pokémon over the Bell Tower! It could be...
Big sisters! I just saw the big shadow of a Pokémon in the Whirl Islands’ waters! It could be...
Zuki: [name]! We’ll be at the Bell Tower. See you there!
Zuki: [name]! We’ll be at the Whirl Islands. See you there!

GROUDON disappeared...

The Tower that binds together the sea, the land, and the sky... GROUDON was not the only Pokémon described in the Hoenn myth... This place may still be hiding its secrets...
The knowledgeable Pokémon Professor may be able to tell you more when you show him GROUDON. Phew! There are so many connections between Pokémon and myths. See you around.

npcs.name: Gsmiddleman1
says: Koga’s daughter succeeded him as the Gym Leader after he joined the Elite Four.

npcs.name: Gswoman1
says: The Safari Zone wasn’t open for a while. Then it moved to Johto before I knew it. It’s sad... It was this city’s main attraction.

npcs.name: Gsboy2
says: One of the Elite Four used to be the Leader of Fuchsia’s Gym.

npcs.name: Juggrer
says: Shard de Berry! Shard de Berry! Yah, yah! I trade Berry for Shard. If ya bring me some Shards, I will give ya three Berries, yah!
Shard de Berry! Shard de Berry! Yah, yah! I trade Berry for Shard. If ya bring me some Shards, I will give ya three Berries, yah! Which Shard will ya trade for de Berry?

npcs.name: Gsbigman
says: I was hoping to buy some Safari Zone souvenirs, but it’s not open! I thought it was closed today, but actually it’s gone! I never saw it coming.

npcs.name: Gswoman3
says: Have you been to the Pal Park? The Safari Zone Warden’s son is running it with his wife. It must run in their family to manage parks.

npcs.name: Picnicgirl 2
says: I’m Janine! How did you know I was real? Let’s battle!
I feel stronger dressing up as Janine.
Or not!

npcs.name: Gsgirl1
says: Well? Wasn’t my disguise perfect?
Fooled you! Hahaha!

npcs.name: Gsleader13
says: Fufufufu... I’m sorry to disappoint you... I’m only joking! I’m the real deal! Janine of Fuchsia Gym, that’s me!
Janine: I see... You have defeated Koga, my father and a member of the Elite Four, to come here. No wonder you are strong! You’ve definitely won... Here’s the Soul Badge. Take it.
[name] received the Soul Badge from Janine!
Janine: You’re so tough! I have a special gift! It’s Poison Jab, a powerful Poison-type move that may poison its victim.

says: Archer: Oh? You managed to get this far...? You must be quite the Trainer. We intend to take over this Radio Tower and officially announce our comeback. That should bring our boss Giovanni back from his solitary training. We are going to regain our former glory... I will not allow you to interfere with our meticulous plans!
Archer: How could this be...? Our dreams have come to naught. I was not up to the task after all. Like Giovanni has done before me, I will disband Team Rocket here today. Farewell...
Director: Oh...! You have already defeated them? Thank you! Your courageous actions have saved Pokémon nationwide. You are well worth this. Please take it!

There used to be a tower right here. When the tower was replaced with the Radio Tower, that Rainbow Wing was found at the top of the tower. I heard from a friend from Cianwood City that you can climb the Bell Tower in Ecruteak City when you have a Rainbow Wing. I have to get back to my office. See you!

There used to be a tower right here. When the tower was replaced with the Radio Tower, that Silver Wing was found at the top of the tower. I heard from a friend from Cianwood City that you can go down the cave at Whirl Islands when you have a Silver Wing. I have to get back to my office. See you!

Oh, I almost forgot! According to my friend from Cianwood City, the legendary Pokémon will not appear if you just go up to the top of the Bell Tower with only that Rainbow Wing. Apparently there is something else you need... Or something like that. I wonder what it was... I can’t remember.

Oh, I almost forgot! According to my friend from Cianwood City, the legendary Pokémon will not appear if you just go down the cave at Whirl Islands with only that Silver Wing. Apparently there is something else you need... Or something like that. I wonder what it was... I can’t remember.
Are you expecting something? This is what they call Fake Out. I really must go back to my office this time. See ya!

npcs.name: Suit
says: Bravo! A promising youth who is about to start the journey of archaeology has just arrived!
I managed to unravel quite a lot of the mystery of UNOWN with your help! Thank you, thank you. Thank you, again!
My staff here at the Ruins Research Center is excellent, and the research makes good progress with absolutely no effort on my part. If you have any questions, feel free to talk to my staff!
What? Just a visitor? Oh, I see... You got me excited for nothing.

npcs.name: Gsassistantm
says: The strange Pokémon you saw in the ruins? They appear to be very much like the drawings on the walls there. Hmm... That must mean there are many different kinds of them...
Huh? I seem to be doing nothing? Come on! I may not look it, but I’m the one who developed the UNOWN Report!
There are odd patterns drawn on the walls of the ruins. They must be the keys for unraveling the mystery of the ruins.

npcs.name: Gsassistantm
says: Thanks to our research and your help, we have unraveled so much about their mystery! We have so many things we don’t know left, of course. Archaeology never ends.
The ruins are about 1,500 years old. That’s all we know about them. But it’s not known why they were built...or by whom.
Wow, did you catch an UNOWN? That’s wonderful! Come to think of it... How come we’ve suddenly started to see UNOWN?

You have to hear this! We are learning more and more about the symbols on the floor! ...It seems that UNOWN were living at the ruins with a human clan. It is thought that this clan made the Pokémon statues underground. The UNOWN were easily scared and wouldn’t go outside. When more and more people started to appear around the ruins, the clan that wished to live in harmony with the UNOWN eventually left... Thanks to our research and your help, we have unraveled so much about their mystery! We have so many things we don’t know left, of course. Archaeology never ends.
I will let you know if I find out anything else.
What? You found a room with UNOWN symbols? That is a big discovery! We will study them right away.
How do you like the UNOWN Report I gave you? UNOWN are recorded as you catch them. It is quite useful!
You have to hear this! This is a big discovery! We have figured out that UNOWN are in a certain order! Let me see your report.
There! I put the UNOWN in the correct order! We may be able to tell more about them.
You have to hear this! This is a big discovery! There are as many UNOWN as there are letters in the alphabet! There have been 26 types confirmed. Why don’t you collect them all?
You have to hear this! This is a big discovery! If you turn on the radio in the ruins, you can receive mysterious radio waves! It’s proof that UNOWN communicate with each other using radio waves!

You have to hear this! This is a big discovery! It was you who solved the stone-panel puzzle that allowed UNOWN to appear. Those tablets are the key to waking up UNOWN! Still... Why would anyone make such a key?
[name] opened the UNOWN Report and made notes!
You have to hear this! This is a big discovery! We have found two new UNOWN symbols! It means that... There must be two more kinds of UNOWN somewhere...

npcs.name: Counterm
says: Welcome, Owner! Should I explain the Safari Zone?
Hi! Is it your first time here at the Safari Zone?

At the Safari Zone, you can enjoy a Safari Game where you are given [name] Safari Balls to try to catch Pokémon. When you have run out of Safari Balls, the game is over. When you see a Pokémon, you can choose to throw Bait or Mud. If you throw Bait, Pokémon tend to stay but will become more difficult to catch. If you throw Mud, it will become easier to catch, but the Pokémon may flee. Have fun at the Safari Zone!
Have fun at the Safari Zone!

npcs.name: Counterm
says: This is the Area Customizer. What would you like to know about?
I am sorry, but this can’t be used yet. Warden Baoba has a great plan for this machine...or so he says. But even we don’t know what it is. It’s a secret.

npcs.name: Counterm
says: Warden Baoba has something important to share with you!
Owner! Welcome to the Safari Zone! For just $[name], you can play the Safari Game. You can roam the wide-open Safari Zone and catch what you like. Would you like to play?

OK. Please come again!

We’ll call for you when you run out of Safari Balls. Well, I hope you enjoy it! Go, and have fun!

npcs.name: Gsgentleman
says: Slow down. Once the next test is ready, I will call you using the Pokégear. Give me some time, OK?
I will explain Object Arrangement. Would you like to know anything?
Show me the GEODUDE once you’ve caught one. They are in the grass closest to the entrance. It shouldn’t take long. Good luck!
You did it! You caught a SANDSHREW! I knew you could do it. You’ve passed the test! You are now the Safari Zone Owner!
I will let you know as soon as I come up with something new, using the Pokégear!

Hi, I have been waiting for you! I had an epiphany! A new attraction! I’ve decided to call it... Object Arrangement! This is going to be fun! You can place objects on the field as you play at the Safari Zone!
Not only that, but the types of Pokémon you see will change depending on the types of objects you place. Isn’t it amazing? I will call you using the Pokégear if something else comes up!
I hope you enjoy it! Go, and have fun!

Oh, wonderful! You’ve caught a GEODUDE! You’ve passed the first test. .................. Huh? Didn’t I tell you that there are two tests? That’s right! Becoming an owner is not that easy. The second test is... Well, I am still preparing for it. I will let you know once it’s ready. You need to wait just a little. I will call you with the Pokégear.
Show me the SANDSHREW once you’ve caught one. SANDSHREW live in the desert! Good luck!
I’ve always wanted to see young people playing at the safari! I thought I might get some new ideas. That should help you complete your Pokédex. That’s what I have been thinking.

By the way, though you are now the Safari Zone Owner, would you kindly continue to pay admission? We have our reasons. Don’t be upset. I’ll keep thinking about how I can create new fun ways to help you complete your Pokédex. Go have fun at the Safari Zone!

npcs.name: Counterm
says: Owner! This is the Safari Zone Link reception. Would you like to know about the Safari Zone Link?
This is the reception for the Safari Zone Link. ...Or should I say...is going to be. We’re still not ready. Please come back later.
This is the Safari Zone Link reception. Would you like to know about the Safari Zone Link?

You can exchange Safari Zones with your friends using the Safari Zone Link. You will be able to play in their Safari Zone! Areas and Pokémon will be different. Beware! The Safari Zone you receive will disappear after 24 hours or if you receive another Safari Zone. To your right is the reception for the Safari Zone Link. To your left is the reception to play in your friend’s Safari Zone. Enjoy the Safari Zone Link!
OK! Enjoy the Safari Zone Link!

npcs.name: Gsbabyboy1
says: Safari, safari, it is so much fun. Safari, safari, so interesting, huh! So many Pokémon are waiting for us! ...That’s a song I made up. I sing it when I am in the Safari Zone.
Airily goes the Safari Ball under the blue sky. Sprinkly goes your sweat to celebrate a friendship. I love the Safari Zone! ...I made a whole jingle out of it. You think anyone would be interested?

npcs.name: Gsoldman1
says: I’ve decided to carry Pokémon drinks. This will be new to me, but I will do my best...

npcs.name: Gswoman1
says: Oh, you want to buy something? Can you wait while I get it ready? Just a minute... ..................

npcs.name: Gswoman2
says: There are many Pokémon to choose from, but nothing beats the cuteness of SLOWPOKE. People often say that I look like one!

npcs.name: Follower Mon Static Butterfree
says: BUTTERFREE: Flu flu.

npcs.name: Follower Mon Static Slowpoke
says: SLOWPOKE: ...Yawn?

npcs.name: Gsbabygirl1
says: I have always wanted to catch my first Pokémon at the Safari Zone.

npcs.name: Workman
says: You may be under the impression there is a sophisticated system to customizing the Safari Zone, right? The real truth is that...

npcs.name: Workman
says: Arrrgh... I am so exhausted... This job uses so much of your energy...

npcs.name: Gsgirl2
says: Those who come to a Pokémon Center often take good care of their Pokémon. Wouldn’t you agree?

npcs.name: Mount 2
says: After a long walk in the mountains to find a Pokémon Center, when you’re just about to fall flat... Then it feels like you are in paradise!

npcs.name: Gsboy1
says: I went to the Gym, raring for battles against Trainers... It turns out, I stumbled into the unused Gym next door. Boy, I was pretty embarrassed.

npcs.name: Gsgirl2
says: Our city was featured on a radio show. It’s nice to hear praise for your city, but it’s a bit embarrassing, too.

npcs.name: Gswoman2
says: This is the house of the Copycat girl. She is so good at being a copycat of the way people talk that it’ll confuse you when you talk to her.
The Copycat girl looked unhappy. She said she lost her cherished Poké Doll--CLEFAIRY.

npcs.name: Gsbigman
says: Chomp... Chew... The manager of the Power Plant used to be a repairman in a small factory. Chew... Chew... His hard work has taken him up the ladder to eventually become the manager of the Power Plant. Chew... Gulp... Quite impressive, don’t you think? Haaah, I’m full!

npcs.name: Gsman1
says: There’s a place called Trainer House in Viridian where Trainers gather from all over the place.

npcs.name: Gsboy2
says: Going into an alley for the first time makes me sorta anxious.

npcs.name: Gswoman1
says: This is Silph Co., famous for Pokémon merchandise. In the past, Team Rocket wanted the company because of that.

npcs.name: Gsmiddleman1
says: You came out from Johto? You can zip back home by hopping on the Magnet Train.

npcs.name: Gsfighter
says: Hello! Karate King, the Fighting Dojo’s master, is in a cave in Johto for further training.

Hello! We are letting the Gym Leaders use the Dojo while the Karate King is away. You can give them a call when you register their numbers. They say they are happy to accept your challenge as long as they are not busy.

npcs.name: Gsleader3
says: Whitney: I never break my promises! Are you ready?
Whitney: You really are strong! But I won’t lose next time!

npcs.name: Gsleader13
says: Janine: I can’t use my ninja technique, but I won’t let you win!
Janine: I lost today, but I’ll win next time!

npcs.name: Gsleader8
says: Clair: ...You are here. Now let’s battle!
Clair: Way to go. ... Now give it your all!

npcs.name: Gsleader12
says: Erika: How are you? Good to see you again! This place really doesn’t suit me, but...let’s ignore that and battle!
Erika: You have grown even stronger...

npcs.name: Gsleader11
says: Misty: So here you are... Don’t make me wait! I’ve heard a lot of good things about you since our last battle. Let me test how good you are!
Misty: Wow! You are getting stronger by the battle!

npcs.name: Gsleader16
says: Blue: Good! Thanks for coming to lose to me!
Blue: Hahaha! My scare tactic doesn’t scare you at all!

npcs.name: Gsleader5
says: Chuck: There you are! Taste my 24-hour training!
Chuck: Wahaha! A battle with you is never boring!

npcs.name: Gsleader14
says: Brock: All right! Time to fulfill our promise! Let’s have a Pokémon battle!
Brock: I’ve lost again... You aren’t adventuring around for nothing!

npcs.name: Gsleader2
says: Bugsy: Good to see you again! Behold my bug research!
Bugsy: You must have studied a lot about Pokémon!

npcs.name: Gsleader10
says: Sabrina: I knew you’d come! I had a feeling. What? We promised each other, so it’s no surprise? ...Well, you may be right.
Sabrina: I know...you will give me a call again sometime.

npcs.name: Gsleader1
says: Falkner: Hi! I’ve been waiting for you! It’s a pleasure to be able to battle you again!
Falkner: Mmm... It’s still a long way to become the best Trainer...

npcs.name: Gsleader9
says: Lt. Surge: Hey! The promise we made! Let’s battle again!
Lt. Surge: Oh no! You are very strong! But I will repay my debt someday.

npcs.name: Gsleader4
says: Morty: I was just talking about you... Let’s battle!
Morty: I’ve lost again... You may have something more than just strength.

npcs.name: Gsleader6
says: Jasmine: We’re here as we promised... Are you prepared?
Jasmine: True to your reputation...

npcs.name: Gsleader7
says: Pryce: Finally. No need for words. A Pokémon battle is the way for us to communicate.
Pryce: Mmm... Impressive!

npcs.name: Gsleader15
says: Blaine: You keep your word. That’s a good thing, kiddo!
Blaine: Waaah! If I had known this Dojo was going to be available, I wouldn’t have needed to rebuild my Gym. Wait! I still did, didn’t I?

npcs.name: Sign
says: “Struggle for vengeance”

npcs.name: Sign
says: “A complicated fracture”

npcs.name: Fishing 2
says: ... ... ... ...I got it! You wanted this!
TM29 is Psychic. It may lower the target’s Sp. Def.

npcs.name: Policeman
says: This is a problem! The machine at the Power Plant is broken, and we’re not receiving electricity! I don’t know how long it will be until we can get the Magnet Train going.
Enjoy the attractive and magnetic journey!

npcs.name: Gsbigman
says: The Magnet Train is a super-modern rail liner that uses electricity and magnets to attain incredible speeds. However, there isn’t any electricity. It’s just an iron box.
Whew... How many times have I gone back and forth between Kanto and Johto?

npcs.name: Gswoman1
says: Before the Magnet Train station was built, there was a house here. A little girl who was called Copycat used to live in it.

npcs.name: Gsgirl1
says: Hi. Do you have a Magnet Train Pass? I have one. All the people in Saffron who ride the Magnet Train have Passes.

npcs.name: Gsleader9
says: Lt. Surge: Oh! I never expected to see you at a place like this! What a coincidence! I can feel great electric power around the Magnet Train station! You had a PIKACHU, didn’t you? How about trading it for my French PIKACHU?
Lt. Surge: Wow! Electrifying! Let’s trade ’em now!
Lt. Surge: Yeah! I’m so ecstatic! I’ll see you around. Good-bye!
Lt. Surge: Shocking! I want to share my feelings for PIKACHU with you! I’m ready anytime, so just bring a PIKACHU, OK?
Lt. Surge: What? That is not the right Pokémon! I won’t trade my PIKACHU for anything other than PIKACHU.

npcs.name: Sign
says: We request that you make sure your Pokémon are well behaved or put away in their Poké Balls so they won’t lick other passengers’ faces. Thank you.

npcs.name: Gswoman6
says: Welcome. This is Silph Co.’s head office building.

npcs.name: Policeman
says: Hey, you! The elevator there is out of order now. Something is wrong with the electricity, and it won’t work right. I feel sorry that you wasted a trip, so here is a gift for you!
It’s Silph Co.’s latest product. It’s not for sale anywhere yet.

npcs.name: Daigo
says: Hello... You’re breaking up... I think it depends on how my dad feels. I see... I’ll be on my way. See you soon.
Steven: Will you trade FORRETRESS for my BELDUM?
Steven: I will ask again. Which color do you choose?
Steven: You are... I remember your eyes. When I see a Trainer whose eyes twinkle, I always remember.

Steven: We meet again! Have you been to Hoenn before? It’s such a beautiful place, with the clearest ocean you can imagine. You should visit sometime. Hey! Why don’t we trade Pokémon? I’ve been looking for FORRETRESS. I can trade my BELDUM for it.
Steven: OK, let’s trade!

Steven: This Pokémon seems to like you a lot. Do you happen to like Steel-type Pokémon? I had a feeling. That particular texture! The cool and glowing bodies! Such uniquenesses are only for Steel-type Pokémon! When it comes to the solitariness and nobleness you sense through the rugged body, which is almost rebuffing when you hug, nothing comes close to BELDUM, I must say... In short, my METAGROSS is truly strong and cool! ... Oh, it seems that I got carried away. It was a pleasure talking to you. Bye!
Steven: You have a Pokédex! So you are also in search of Pokémon. Let me see... I think I can help you with that. Let’s say that you have stones in front of you. Which color would you pick?
Steven: That’s too bad.
Steven: Are you telling me that you think that’s a FORRETRESS?
Steven: You don’t see FORRETRESS in the Hoenn region. It’s my first time to actually see one. Thank you so much! Oh, look at the time. I really must go.
Steven: I see... For the choice you’ve made, I’d like to give you this Pokémon. Except your party is full. Why don’t you go to the PC to make some room? I’ll be waiting here.
Steven: You chose correctly! I will give you [name]!
[name] received the [name] from Steven!
Would you like to give a nickname to [name]?
Steven: You did a great job naming it!
Steven: Take good care of it. Your caring for it will make me very happy.

npcs.name: Sign
says: This elevator is out of order. It may electrocute you. Stay away.

npcs.name: Gsmiddleman1
says: My daughter likes to mimic people. Her mimicry has earned her the nickname Copycat around here.

npcs.name: Middlewoman1 2
says: My daughter is unique... She would make friends, then her mimicry would scare them away... She only has a few friends.
She recently lost the Poké Doll that a boy gave her three years ago. Ever since then, she’s gotten even better at mimicry...

npcs.name: Follower Mon Static Blissey
says: BLISSEY: Bliisii!

npcs.name: Gsgirl1
says: [name]: Hi! Do you like Pokémon? [name]: Uh, no, I just asked you. [name]: Huh? You’re strange!
[name]: Hi. You must like Pokémon. [name]: No, not me. I asked you. [name]: Pardon? You’re weird!
Copycat: Hmm? Quit mimicking? But that’s my main hobby!
[name]: Hi! Thanks a lot for the Magnet Train Pass! [name]: Pardon? [name]: Is it that fun to mimic my every move?
Copycat: You bet! It’s a scream!
Copycat: Yay! That’s my CLEFAIRY Poké Doll! See the tear where the right arm is sewn on? That’s proof! OK. I’ll give you this Magnet Train Pass as I promised!
Copycat: You show it at the ticket gate to get on the Magnet Train. The rail-company man gave me that when they tore down our old house for the station.

[name]: Hi! I heard that you lost your cherished Poké Doll. [name]: If I find it, you’ll give me a Magnet Train Pass? [name]: I’ll go find it for you. [name]: You think you lost it when you went to Vermilion City?
Copycat: Pardon? I shouldn’t decide what you should do? But I’m really worried... What if someone finds it?

npcs.name: Jupetta
says: This Poké Doll looks just like the real thing... Aw! It moved! It’s a real BANETTE!
BANETTE: Giggle!

npcs.name: Sign
says: This is a nose-like Poké Doll... It is a NOSEPASS Poké Doll!

npcs.name: Sign
says: This is a flowerlike Poké Doll... It is a CHERRIM Poké Doll!

npcs.name: Sign
says: It’s a CLEFAIRY! Huh? Oh, right. It’s a CLEFAIRY Poké Doll.
It’s a CLEFAIRY Poké Doll. It has a tear where the right arm was sewn on.

npcs.name: Gswoman1
says: What are Johto’s Pokémon Centers like? ...Oh, I see. So they’re not much different from the ones in Kanto. Then I’ll get my friend in Johto to catch a MARILL and trade it to me!

npcs.name: Mount 2
says: I just happened to come through the Rock Tunnel. There was some commotion at the Power Plant.
Adventures are not always full of oceans and mountains! Daily life can be quite adventurous! ...By the way, I’ve heard people talking about a cave in Cerulean. Do you know anything?

npcs.name: Gsboy1
says: Silph Co.’s head office and the Magnet Train station-- they’re the places to see in Saffron.

npcs.name: Gsman3
says: There’s a big Radio Tower in Lavender Town.

npcs.name: Gswoman3
says: I want to become stronger, but I’m not good yet... Could you show me how sometime?

npcs.name: Sunglasses
says: Yo, legend in the making! A Trainer as skilled as you doesn’t need to be told how to deal with Psychic-type Pokémon, right? I expect great things from you! Good luck!
That was another fantastic battle!

npcs.name: Gsleader10
says: Sabrina: I knew you were coming... Three years ago I had a vision of your arrival. You’re after my Badge. I don’t enjoy battling, but it’s my duty as a Gym Leader to confer Badges on anyone who has proven him- or herself worthy. Since you wish it, I will show you my psychic powers!
Sabrina: Your power... It far exceeds what I foresaw... Maybe it isn’t possible to fully predict what the future holds... OK, you win. You earned yourself the Marsh Badge.
[name] received the Marsh Badge!
Sabrina: I failed to accurately predict your power. That means that your power is beyond my psychic ability. You deserve this. Please take this TM, too!
Sabrina: Your love for your Pokémon smashed my psychic abilities... The ability to love, I think, is some kind of psychic ability...
Sabrina: It contains Skill Swap! It swaps Abilities between the user and the target. You will become a celebrated and beloved Champion!

npcs.name: Sign
says: Saffron City Pokémon Gym
Saffron City Pokémon Gym Leader: Sabrina Certified Trainer! [name]

npcs.name: Gsleader15
says: Blaine: Hey, you! My Gym on Cinnabar Island was burned down by the eruption! But I will not give up! Take a look at this cave. We have turned it into a Gym, and I am still acting as a Gym Leader! I will give you the Gym Badge if you manage to defeat me! Are you ready? Here we go!
Blaine: Awesome. I have burned out... Take this Volcano Badge!
[name] received the Volcano Badge from Blaine!
Blaine: Here, I will give you this, too. It’s called Overheat! It has a slight drawback, but it’s powerful and well worth it!
Blaine: My Fire-type Pokémon will be even stronger! Just you watch!
Blaine: I did lose this time, but I’m going to win next time. When I rebuild my Cinnabar Gym, we have to hold a rematch.

npcs.name: Sunglasses
says: Yo! Legend in the making! This Gym has many Trainers and rocks in the way from the rebuilding. It sure won’t be easy to get to Blaine! But keep your cool and defeat the Trainers one by one, and you will surely find the path!
The Gym Leader rebuilding his Gym and the Trainer from Johto who has come to challenge that Gym Leader... I have witnessed a hot battle!

npcs.name: Assistantm
says: A white lab coat is a researcher’s life. We may be living in a cave like this, but we never forget to do the laundry.
This white lab coat makes me feel like I have become smarter for some reason.

npcs.name: Assistantm
says: Blaine may have lost his Gym, but he never gives up. His perseverance is what motivates me!
Together with Blaine, we will rebuild our Gym!

npcs.name: Assistantm
says: We lost the Gym on Cinnabar Island and felt lost before we came here.
We take a step back when we are defeated... Don’t you think we are downright honest? Never put us in the same category as Scientists who help bad guys.

npcs.name: Gsassistantm
says: Wow, to see a Gym in a cave like this? I’d love to explore it.
Bitterness leads to improvement tomorrow.

npcs.name: Gsassistantm
says: I am in the middle of collecting battle records. Can you help me?
I didn’t expect you to be so good! Who in the world are you?

npcs.name: Gsassistantm
says: Ooh! You look easily defeated!
Pardon me! I failed to sense how strong you are.

npcs.name: Mount 2
says: By the way, we happen to have a person at the cabin. Any Trainer should know who she is. The famous Trainer from Sinnoh! She is traveling around to study myths and ancient ruins. Isn’t that something?

npcs.name: Champion
says: Cynthia: The Sinjoh Ruins are what remains of a temple built to show respect for ARCEUS.
Cynthia: Once you are ready, choose a circle and stand in the middle of it.

Cynthia: This is the Mystri Stage. The mythical stage built to show respect for ARCEUS. It is said that people used to celebrate its magnificent might with music and dance. Some people in Johto still pass down this tradition.
Cynthia: According to an ancient document, time, space, and antimatter, or what combined we call the world, shall be born when ARCEUS stands on the Mystri Stage.
Cynthia: The Mystri Stage allows a single ARCEUS and nothing else to get on the stage... If you wish to go up there, you have to deposit your other Pokémon in a PC Box at the cabin.
Cynthia: This is where one might say, “The lead enters the Mystri Stage at last.” All my study of ruins and Pokémon mythology in Sinnoh may have been to bring you up on this stage here today...
Cynthia: Depicted on the Mystri Stage are the Pokémon that shaped this world. The circle in the middle is ARCEUS, the origin of it all...
Cynthia: This is the pattern that represents PALKIA, the master of space and dimensions...
Cynthia: This is the pattern that represents DIALGA, the guardian of time...
Cynthia: This is the pattern that represents GIRATINA, the ruler of the world that is on the opposite side of ours, the world of antimatter...
Cynthia: ARCEUS has accepted you as a Trainer. ARCEUS, having shaped the world, is said to show you a glimpse of its true power. The power of possibly making life appear out of nothing...
Cynthia: It seems that something will happen when you choose one of the circles... You’ll want to be well prepared.

npcs.name: Champion
says: Cynthia: My name is Cynthia. I am a Pokémon Trainer. The Sinjoh Ruins remind me of Sinnoh, where I come from. Initially, I thought it was because it snows a lot here as well. But that was not it. A long time ago...people came from Sinnoh to live here. They must have built a temple here while longing for home. That’s why we call these the Sinjoh Ruins...

Cynthia: I wouldn’t assume you managed to get here by yourself. This is a heavy-snowfall area where the snowbound land freezes you to the core... Talk to the old man if you wish to go back. ABRA should be able to take you where you come from.
Cynthia: You are... a Pokémon Trainer? I can sense strong power coming from your Poké Ball...
Cynthia: I feel a familiar presence... The power of DIALGA... PALKIA... or could it be GIRATINA? It’s similar, but not quite the same...
Cynthia: Have you got time? Can you come to the Sinjoh Ruins with me? Call it a Trainer’s intuition. When you and your Pokémon step onto that stage, something will happen.

npcs.name: Mount 2
says: A long time ago, people used to draw life from Pokémon and also give their lives to those Pokémon... That shows that people and Pokémon used to be more closely bonded with each other. When people moved from place to place, the myths and legends of Pokémon and their power would also be carried with those people. That’s how myths and legends from each region are blended with each other. The ancient ruins here have inherited the legends from both the Ruins of Alph in Johto and the Spear Pillar in Sinnoh. That is proof that people from Johto and Sinnoh blended together as a group.
Well, hello! We meet again! Cynthia has gone back to Sinnoh. She is the Sinnoh League Champion. She studies various ruins despite her tight schedule. How wonderful she is!

ARCEUS is said to have come out of an Egg. Johto people believe that Pokémon Eggs are the vessels of life, and thus something astounding. Places far from each other can share similar myths and legends... That’s quite interesting, isn’t it?

npcs.name: Gsoldman1
says: You seem so out of place, not even knowing why you are here. Do you want my ABRA to use a special power to take you home?
OK. OK. Picture your house in your mind...
OK... OK... The best of luck to you!

npcs.name: Follower Mon Static Abra
says: ABRA: Aabra...

If I were fit, my Pokémon would’ve punished them... Ah, it can’t be helped. [name], show them how gutsy you are in my place!

npcs.name: Rkanbum3
says: Proton: What do we have here? I am often labeled as the scariest and cruelest guy in Team Rocket... I strongly urge you not to interfere with our business!

Proton: Humph... Team Rocket was indeed broken up three years ago. But we continued our activities underground. A small obstacle like you won’t be much of a problem for our mission. I advise you to be very afraid of what is to come!
Kurt: Way to go, [name]! Team Rocket has taken off. My back’s better, too. Let’s get out of here.

npcs.name: Yadon
says: A SLOWPOKE with its tail cut off... Huh? It has Mail. Read it?

[name] read the Mail. Be good and look after the house with Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.
Love, Dad

npcs.name: Yadon
says: A SLOWPOKE with its tail cut off...

npcs.name: Gsassistantm
says: I’m waiting to see SLOWPOKE’s moment of evolution. Through observation, I made a new discovery. A SLOWPOKE with a King’s Rock often gets bitten by a SHELLDER. Here, I’ll share a King’s Rock with you.
I’m going to be like SLOWPOKE. I’ll wait patiently so I can see one evolve.

When a Pokémon learns Flash, you can illuminate caves no matter how dark they may be. You can try it on BELLSPROUT, for example...
I hope you learn and grow from your journey.

npcs.name: Babyboy1 2

npcs.name: Gsgentleman
says: Hello, [name]! Did you come see me about my Pokémon again? No? Oh... I had more tales to tell...

Good! Then listen up! So...my precious RAPIDASH... It’s...cute...lovely...smart... adorable...irresistible...plus... amazing... Don’t you think so? Oh, so...wild...beautiful... kind... I love it! I want to give you this present!
It’s a Rare Candy that makes Pokémon stronger. I prefer making my Pokémon stronger by battling, so you can have it.
How disappointing... Come back if you want to listen to me again!

npcs.name: Gsbabyboy1
says: Did you know that Pokégear allows you to put marks and memos on its Map? I’d love to have one of those Pokégears, but my mom won’t let me.

npcs.name: Gsleader1
says: Falkner: I’m Falkner, the Violet City Pokémon Gym Leader! People say you can clip Flying-type Pokémon’s wings with a jolt of electricity... I won’t allow such insults to bird Pokémon! I’ll show you the real power of the magnificent bird Pokémon!
Falkner: ...For pity’s sake! My dad’s cherished bird Pokémon... But a defeat is a defeat. All right. Take this official Pokémon League Badge. This one is the Zephyr Badge.
[name] received the Zephyr Badge from Falkner!
Falkner: With that Badge, Pokémon, including traded Pokémon up to Lv. 20, will obey you without question. It also enables you to use the hidden move Rock Smash anytime outside of battle.

Falkner: There are Pokémon Gyms in cities and towns ahead. You should test your skills at these Gyms. As for your next move... I would suggest Azalea Town. I’m going to train harder to become the greatest Bird Keeper of all!

Falkner: By using a TM, a Pokémon will instantly learn a new move. Think before you act--a TM can be used only once. TM51 contains Roost. It restores half the max HP. There are Pokémon Gyms in cities and towns ahead. Make good use of them! As for your next move... I would suggest Azalea Town.

npcs.name: Sunglasses
says: Yo, Champ in the making! I’m no Trainer, but I can give some advice! Believe me! If you believe, then a Championship dream can come true. You believe? Then listen. The Grass type is weak against the Flying type. Keep this in mind.
Nice battle! Keep it up, and you’ll be the Champ in no time at all!

npcs.name: Sunglasses
says: Yo! Champ in the making! You must be here to challenge Falkner, the Gym Leader, right? You are quite welcome. ...Almost! This city has a tower called the Sprout Tower where Trainers come to train themselves. Challenging Falkner may be too difficult if you haven’t gone through their training. Ha ha ha!

says: Pokémon can hold items like a Potion or an Antidote. But they don’t appear to know how to use man-made items.

[name], will you take this Egg?

[name] received the Egg from the assistant!

That’s how I came here to deliver the Egg to you. It seems that a Pokémon will hatch from it only when you keep it in your party of Pokémon. That’s another reason we’ve chosen you, [name]. npcs.name: Gsman1
says: A guy named Bill made the Pokémon PC storage system. You can access the Pokémon storage system using the PC at the reception there. Why don’t you try it once?

npcs.name: Gsgentleman
says: It was about three years ago. This group of thugs called Team Rocket was involved in wrongdoing. They were abusing Pokémon. But! Bad things never last! A boy did a wonderful job and Team Rocket was disbanded!

npcs.name: Gsboy1
says: Pokémon are really smart. Traded Pokémon might not listen to you right away. For example, high-level Pokémon sometimes refuse to obey when you don’t have enough Gym Badges.

npcs.name: Instructor
says: Primo: Hello! I should be a familiar face to every Pokémon fan. I’m from the TV show, “The Show Me Show!” I am Primo, the big brother! Today, would you, one of my fans, tell me what you think of me?
Primo: Oh my...! Is that how you feel about me?! I never thought of it that way before. By the way, how do you like the way I am so exciting and fun?

You cannot possibly mean that you are not interested in the big brother...? Arrgh, that cannot be true! You are just busy right now, aren’t you? That must be it! Why don’t you answer my questions when you’ve got time for me? See you!
Primo: Truly? That gives me all-new energy so I can work even harder! Great feedback! It’ll help me a lot. Thank you for your continued support!

Primo: ...! You are no ordinary fan, knowing such a thing! You’re a Trainer, right? I’ll pull some strings for you. I think I can swing a deal to get you a new wallpaper for your PC Boxes. Make sure you keep your channel tuned to “The Show Me Show!” And don’t forget about me, the big brother!
Primo: ...! You are no ordinary fan, knowing such a thing! You are a Trainer, right? I’ll pull some strings for you. I think I can swing a deal and give you this Egg. You take good care of it!

[name] received the [name] Egg from Primo!

says: Hmm... Can you tell me what kind of Trainer you like best?

Which kind of Trainer would you like to be?
[name] is the kind of Trainer you want to be?

Talk to me again if you want to let me know what kind of Trainer you like best.

npcs.name: Gsbigman

So, want to know how to raise Pokémon well?
Oh! Smart student you are! Nothing more do I teach! Good to Pokémon you must be!

Fine! Teach you, I will! If Pokémon come out in battle even briefly, some Exp. Points it gets. Keep out weak Pokémon, switch in battle quick! This way, weak Pokémon very strong become! More from me you want to hear?
So, want to know how to battle well?
Fine! Teach you, I will! Pokémon have goods and bads because many types. High-level Pokémon not win always if bad types. Pokémon with good types for the foe, you choose. Smart battle, it is!

npcs.name: Sign
says: The blackboard explains Pokémon status changes in battle.
Read which topic?
If poisoned, a Pokémon steadily loses HP. The poison lingers after the battle, and HP is lost as you walk. To cure it, use an Antidote.
Paralysis reduces speed and may prevent movement. It remains after battle, so use a Parlyz Heal.
If asleep, your Pokémon can use only certain moves, such as Sleep Talk and Snore. A sleeping Pokémon doesn’t wake up after battle. Wake it up with an Awakening.
A burn consumes HP, little by little, and also reduces the Attack stat. A burn lingers after battle. Use a Burn Heal as the cure.
If your Pokémon is frozen, it can’t do a thing. It remains frozen after battle. Thaw it out with an Ice Heal.

masterball.name: Master Ball
masterball.description: The best Ball with the ultimate level of performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

ultraball.name: Ultra Ball
ultraball.description: An ultra-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.

greatball.name: Great Ball
greatball.description: A good, high-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.

pokeball.name: Poké Ball
pokeball.description: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It is thrown like a ball at the target. It is designed as a capsule system.

safariball.name: Safari Ball
safariball.description: A special Poké Ball that is used only in the Great Marsh. It is decorated in a camouflage pattern.

netball.name: Net Ball
netball.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.

diveball.name: Dive Ball
diveball.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Pokémon that live in the sea.

nestball.name: Nest Ball
nestball.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on weaker Pokémon in the wild.

repeatball.name: Repeat Ball
repeatball.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Pokémon species that were previously caught.

timerball.name: Timer Ball
timerball.description: A somewhat different Ball that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.

luxuryball.name: Luxury Ball
luxuryball.description: A comfortable Poké Ball that makes a caught wild Pokémon quickly grow friendly.

premierball.name: Premier Ball
premierball.description: A somewhat rare Poké Ball that has been specially made to commemorate an event of some sort.

duskball.name: Dusk Ball
duskball.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark places like caves.

healball.name: Heal Ball
healball.description: A remedial Poké Ball that restores the caught Pokémon’s HP and eliminates any status problem.

quickball.name: Quick Ball
quickball.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that provides a better catch rate if it is used at the start of a wild encounter.

cherishball.name: Cherish Ball
cherishball.description: A quite rare Poké Ball that has been specially crafted to commemorate an occasion of some sort.

potion.name: Potion
potion.description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: A spray-type medicine. It lifts the effect of poison from one Pokémon.

burnheal.name: Burn Heal
burnheal.description: A spray-type medicine. It heals a single Pokémon that is suffering from a burn.

iceheal.name: Ice Heal
iceheal.description: A spray-type medicine. It defrosts a Pokémon that has been frozen solid.

awakening.name: Awakening
awakening.description: A spray-type medicine. It awakens a Pokémon from the clutches of sleep.

parlyzheal.name: Parlyz Heal
parlyzheal.description: A spray-type medicine. It eliminates paralysis from a single Pokémon.

fullrestore.name: Full Restore
fullrestore.description: A medicine that fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of a single Pokémon.

maxpotion.name: Max Potion
maxpotion.description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It completely restores the HP of a single Pokémon.

hyperpotion.name: Hyper Potion
hyperpotion.description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.

superpotion.name: Super Potion
superpotion.description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

fullheal.name: Full Heal
fullheal.description: A spray-type medicine. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

revive.name: Revive
revive.description: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It restores half the Pokémon’s maximum HP.

maxrevive.name: Max Revive
maxrevive.description: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It fully restores the Pokémon’s HP.

freshwater.name: Fresh Water
freshwater.description: Water with a high mineral content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

sodapop.name: Soda Pop
sodapop.description: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.

lemonade.name: Lemonade
lemonade.description: A very sweet drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 80 points.
