silkscarf.name: Silk Scarf
silkscarf.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of Normal-type moves.

upgrade.name: Up-Grade
upgrade.description: A transparent device filled with all sorts of data. It was produced by Silph Co.

shellbell.name: Shell Bell
shellbell.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder’s HP is restored a little every time it inflicts damage.

seaincense.name: Sea Incense
seaincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is incense with a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

laxincense.name: Lax Incense
laxincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The tricky aroma of this incense lowers the foe’s accuracy.

luckypunch.name: Lucky Punch
luckypunch.description: An item to be held by CHANSEY. It is a pair of gloves that boosts CHANSEY’s critical-hit ratio.

metalpowder.name: Metal Powder
metalpowder.description: An item to be held by DITTO. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Defense stat.

thickclub.name: Thick Club
thickclub.description: An item to be held by CUBONE or MAROWAK. It is a hard bone of some sort that boosts the Attack stat.

stick.name: Stick
stick.description: An item to be held by FARFETCH’D. It is a very long and stiff stalk of leek that boosts the critical-hit ratio.

redscarf.name: Red Scarf
redscarf.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the “Cool” aspect of the holder in a Contest in Sinnoh.

bluescarf.name: Blue Scarf
bluescarf.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the “Beauty” aspect of the holder in a Contest in Sinnoh.

pinkscarf.name: Pink Scarf
pinkscarf.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the “Cute” aspect of the holder in a Contest in Sinnoh.

greenscarf.name: Green Scarf
greenscarf.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the “Smart” aspect of the holder in a Contest in Sinnoh.

yellowscarf.name: Yellow Scarf
yellowscarf.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the “Tough” aspect of the holder in a Contest in Sinnoh.

widelens.name: Wide Lens
widelens.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of moves.

muscleband.name: Muscle Band
muscleband.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a headband that slightly boosts the power of physical moves.

wiseglasses.name: Wise Glasses
wiseglasses.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a thick pair of glasses that slightly boosts the power of special moves.

expertbelt.name: Expert Belt
expertbelt.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a well-worn belt that slightly boosts the power of supereffective moves.

lightclay.name: Light Clay
lightclay.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of barrier moves like Light Screen and Reflect used by the holder.

lifeorb.name: Life Orb
lifeorb.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves, but at the cost of some HP on each hit.

powerherb.name: Power Herb
powerherb.description: A single-use item to be held by a Pokémon. It allows the immediate use of a move that charges on the first turn.

toxicorb.name: Toxic Orb
toxicorb.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that badly poisons the holder in battle.

flameorb.name: Flame Orb
flameorb.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that inflicts a burn on the holder in battle.

quickpowder.name: Quick Powder
quickpowder.description: An item to be held by DITTO. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Speed stat.

focussash.name: Focus Sash
focussash.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If it has full HP, the holder will endure one potential KO attack, leaving 1 HP.

zoomlens.name: Zoom Lens
zoomlens.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder moves after the foe, its accuracy will be boosted.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.description: A Pokémon held item that boosts a move used consecutively. Its effect is reset if another move is used.

ironball.name: Iron Ball
ironball.description: A Pokémon held item that cuts Speed. It makes Flying-type and levitating holders susceptible to Ground moves.

laggingtail.name: Lagging Tail
laggingtail.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is tremendously heavy and makes the holder move slower than usual.

destinyknot.name: Destiny Knot
destinyknot.description: A long, thin, bright red string to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder becomes infatuated, the foe does too.

blacksludge.name: Black Sludge
blacksludge.description: A held item that gradually restores the HP of Poison-type Pokémon. It inflicts damage on all other types.

icyrock.name: Icy Rock
icyrock.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Hail used by the holder.

smoothrock.name: Smooth Rock
smoothrock.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Sandstorm used by the holder.

heatrock.name: Heat Rock
heatrock.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Sunny Day used by the holder.

damprock.name: Damp Rock
damprock.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Rain Dance used by the holder.

gripclaw.name: Grip Claw
gripclaw.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of multiturn attacks like Bind and Wrap.

choicescarf.name: Choice Scarf
choicescarf.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This scarf boosts Speed, but allows the use of only one kind of move.

stickybarb.name: Sticky Barb
stickybarb.description: A held item that damages the holder on every turn. It may latch on to foes that touch the holder.

powerbracer.name: Power Bracer
powerbracer.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes Attack gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

powerbelt.name: Power Belt
powerbelt.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes Defense gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

powerlens.name: Power Lens
powerlens.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes Sp. Atk gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

powerband.name: Power Band
powerband.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes Sp. Def gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

poweranklet.name: Power Anklet
poweranklet.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes Speed gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

powerweight.name: Power Weight
powerweight.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes HP gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

shedshell.name: Shed Shell
shedshell.description: A tough, discarded carapace to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to switch with a waiting Pokémon in battle.

bigroot.name: Big Root
bigroot.description: A Pokémon held item that boosts the power of HP-stealing moves to let the holder recover more HP.

choicespecs.name: Choice Specs
choicespecs.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These distinctive glasses boost Sp. Atk, but allow only one kind of move to be used.

flameplate.name: Flame Plate
flameplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.

splashplate.name: Splash Plate
splashplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

zapplate.name: Zap Plate
zapplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

meadowplate.name: Meadow Plate
meadowplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

icicleplate.name: Icicle Plate
icicleplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ice-type moves.

fistplate.name: Fist Plate
fistplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fighting-type moves.

toxicplate.name: Toxic Plate
toxicplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.

earthplate.name: Earth Plate
earthplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

skyplate.name: Sky Plate
skyplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.

mindplate.name: Mind Plate
mindplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

insectplate.name: Insect Plate
insectplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Bug-type moves.

stoneplate.name: Stone Plate
stoneplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

spookyplate.name: Spooky Plate
spookyplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.

dracoplate.name: Draco Plate
dracoplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dragon-type moves.

dreadplate.name: Dread Plate
dreadplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dark-type moves.

ironplate.name: Iron Plate
ironplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Steel-type moves.

oddincense.name: Odd Incense
oddincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

rockincense.name: Rock Incense
rockincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

fullincense.name: Full Incense
fullincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that makes the holder bloated and slow moving.

waveincense.name: Wave Incense
waveincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

roseincense.name: Rose Incense
roseincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

luckincense.name: Luck Incense
luckincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles a battle’s prize money if the holding Pokémon joins in.

pureincense.name: Pure Incense
pureincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the first one in the party.

protector.name: Protector
protector.description: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

electirizer.name: Electirizer
electirizer.description: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

magmarizer.name: Magmarizer
magmarizer.description: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

dubiousdisc.name: Dubious Disc
dubiousdisc.description: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.

reapercloth.name: Reaper Cloth
reapercloth.description: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

razorclaw.name: Razor Claw
razorclaw.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sharply hooked claw that ups the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

razorfang.name: Razor Fang
razorfang.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the foe to flinch when the holder inflicts damage.

tm01.name: TM01
tm01.description: The user focuses its mind before launching this attack. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

tm02.name: TM02
tm02.description: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.

tm03.name: TM03
tm03.description: The foe is hit with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.

tm04.name: TM04
tm04.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tm05.name: TM05
tm05.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

tm06.name: TM06
tm06.description: A move that leaves the foe badly poisoned. This poison damage worsens every turn.

tm07.name: TM07
tm07.description: Summons a hailstorm that lasts for five turns. The hailstorm damages all types except Ice.

tm08.name: TM08
tm08.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

tm09.name: TM09
tm09.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

tm10.name: TM10
tm10.description: A variable move that changes type and power depending on the hidden ability of the Pokémon using it.

tm11.name: TM11
tm11.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tm12.name: TM12
tm12.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.

tm13.name: TM13
tm13.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

tm14.name: TM14
tm14.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

tm15.name: TM15
tm15.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tm16.name: TM16
tm16.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

tm17.name: TM17
tm17.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tm18.name: TM18
tm18.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

tm19.name: TM19
tm19.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tm20.name: TM20
tm20.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems like poison, paralysis, burn, and sleep.

tm21.name: TM21
tm21.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tm22.name: TM22
tm22.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

tm23.name: TM23
tm23.description: The foe is slammed with a sturdy tail of steel. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat if it hits.

tm24.name: TM24
tm24.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

tm25.name: TM25
tm25.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

tm26.name: TM26
tm26.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

tm27.name: TM27
tm27.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tm28.name: TM28
tm28.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

tm29.name: TM29
tm29.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tm30.name: TM30
tm30.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tm31.name: TM31
tm31.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

tm32.name: TM32
tm32.description: The user begins moving so quickly that it creates illusory copies to raise its evasiveness.

tm33.name: TM33
tm33.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

tm34.name: TM34
tm34.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

tm35.name: TM35
tm35.description: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

tm36.name: TM36
tm36.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the foe. It may also poison the target.

tm37.name: TM37
tm37.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

tm38.name: TM38
tm38.description: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

tm39.name: TM39
tm39.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It lowers the foe’s Speed.

tm40.name: TM40
tm40.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then strikes. The attack lands without fail.

tm41.name: TM41
tm41.description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

tm42.name: TM42
tm42.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tm43.name: TM43
tm43.description: An attack move with effects that vary depending on the user’s environment.

tm44.name: TM44
tm44.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tm45.name: TM45
tm45.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tm46.name: TM46
tm46.description: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

tm47.name: TM47
tm47.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

tm48.name: TM48
tm48.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange abilities with the foe.

tm49.name: TM49
tm49.description: The user steals the effects of any healing or status-changing move the foe attempts to use.

tm50.name: TM50
tm50.description: The user attacks the foe at full power using fiery energy. It also sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk.

tm51.name: TM51
tm51.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

tm52.name: TM52
tm52.description: The user attacks at full power. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat if it hits.

tm53.name: TM53
tm53.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tm54.name: TM54
tm54.description: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

tm55.name: TM55
tm55.description: If the foe’s HP is down to under half, this attack will hit with double the power.

tm56.name: TM56
tm56.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

tm57.name: TM57
tm57.description: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

tm58.name: TM58
tm58.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tm59.name: TM59
tm59.description: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

tm60.name: TM60
tm60.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tm61.name: TM61
tm61.description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish white flame at the foe to inflict a burn.

tm62.name: TM62
tm62.description: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

tm63.name: TM63
tm63.description: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

tm64.name: TM64
tm64.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

tm65.name: TM65
tm65.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tm66.name: TM66
tm66.description: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user can use this attack after the foe, its power is doubled.

tm67.name: TM67
tm67.description: The user recycles a single-use item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

tm68.name: TM68
tm68.description: The user charges the foe using every bit of its power. It must rest on the next turn to recover.

tm69.name: TM69
tm69.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It sharply raises the Speed stat.

tm70.name: TM70
tm70.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

tm71.name: TM71
tm71.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tm72.name: TM72
tm72.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

tm73.name: TM73
tm73.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

tm74.name: TM74
tm74.description: The user tackles the foe from a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

tm75.name: TM75
tm75.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

tm76.name: TM76
tm76.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

tm77.name: TM77
tm77.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

tm78.name: TM78
tm78.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

tm79.name: TM79
tm79.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

tm80.name: TM80
tm80.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

tm81.name: TM81
tm81.description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

tm82.name: TM82
tm82.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tm83.name: TM83
tm83.description: The user draws power from the Berry it is holding to attack. The Berry determines its type and power.

tm84.name: TM84
tm84.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped with poison. It may also poison the foe.

tm85.name: TM85
tm85.description: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

tm86.name: TM86
tm86.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

tm87.name: TM87
tm87.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

tm88.name: TM88
tm88.description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

tm89.name: TM89
tm89.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

tm90.name: TM90
tm90.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tm91.name: TM91
tm91.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it in one shot. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tm92.name: TM92
tm92.description: The user creates a bizarre space in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

hm01.name: HM01
hm01.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

hm02.name: HM02
hm02.description: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used to fly to any familiar town.

hm03.name: HM03
hm03.description: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used to cross water.

hm04.name: HM04
hm04.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

hm05.name: HM05
hm05.description: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool. It can also be used to traverse whirlpools.

hm06.name: HM06
hm06.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

hm07.name: HM07
hm07.description: The user charges the foe at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

hm08.name: HM08
hm08.description: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

lootsack.name: Loot Sack
lootsack.description: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry loot obtained in the coal mine.

rulebook.name: Rule Book
rulebook.description: It lists the rules for holding battles. For linked battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.

pokeradar.name: Poké Radar
pokeradar.description: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

pointcard.name: Point Card
pointcard.description: A card that lists the Battle Points you have earned.

journal.name: Journal
journal.description: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.

sealcase.name: Seal Case
sealcase.description: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the Capsule cases of Poké Balls.

fashioncase.name: Fashion Case
fashioncase.description: A fancy case for the tidy arrangement and storage of whimsical Pokémon Accessories.

sealbag.name: Seal Bag
sealbag.description: A tiny bag that can hold ten Seals for decorating Poké Balls.

palpad.name: Pal Pad
palpad.description: A convenient notepad that is used for registering your friends, Friend Codes, and keeping a record of game play.

workskey.name: Works Key
workskey.description: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

oldcharm.name: Old Charm
oldcharm.description: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.

galactickey.name: Galactic Key
galactickey.description: A card key for disengaging security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.

redchain.name: Red Chain
redchain.description: A mythical chain that is said to link the legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.

townmap.name: Town Map
townmap.description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

vsseeker.name: Vs. Seeker
vsseeker.description: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

coincase.name: Coin Case
coincase.description: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 50,000 coins.

oldrod.name: Old Rod
oldrod.description: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

goodrod.name: Good Rod
goodrod.description: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

superrod.name: Super Rod
superrod.description: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

sprayduck.name: Sprayduck
sprayduck.description: A watering can shaped like a PSYDUCK. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.

poffincase.name: Poffin Case
poffincase.description: A case for storing Poffin cooked from Berries.

bicycle.name: Bicycle
bicycle.description: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.

suitekey.name: Suite Key
suitekey.description: A key to one of the suites at the luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

oaksletter.name: Oak’s Letter
oaksletter.description: A letter from Prof. Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Rt. 224.

lunarwing.name: Lunar Wing
lunarwing.description: A feather that glows like the moon. It is said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.

membercard.name: Member Card
membercard.description: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.

azureflute.name: Azure Flute
azureflute.description: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. It is unknown who made it.

ssticket.name: S.S. Ticket
ssticket.description: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

contestpass.name: Contest Pass
